summary.plain: The first Gamma-Gamma detector at ADONE: scintillator counters behind lead plates that convert photons, with spark chambers to show the resulting showers.
summary.technical: Gamma-Gamma detector: scintillation counters, lead converters and spark chambers; Frascati and Rome group.

technology.quote: Its experimental setup included scintillator counters following lead plates for the conversion of the photons and spark chambers to show the produced showers.
technology.value: Scintillator counters following lead plates (photon conversion) and spark chambers to show the produced showers
